scope: History trend distinguishes valid observations, known gaps, invalid samples and last valid value from the same query, including late samples without rolling back current state
environment: Isolated loopback-only software fixture. A/B Modbus runtime points with declared poll_period 1000 ms and synthetic observations; one SIOT variable with history but no declared cadence; no hardware and zero protocol writes.

dataset.window: 1 hour ending at query time; [start,end] both endpoints included
dataset.A: 600 good observations, one source_expired event, one timeout event, recovery observations, and one late good sample observed at 11:49:19 but received at 12:07:39
dataset.B: continuous good observations used as the normal control
dataset.siot: three native value points with no recorded quality and no declared sample interval

browser_journey.gap_rendering: A's outage is drawn as a gap band with known reasons 采样过期/读取超时; a later boundary interval is labeled 原因未知（无质量记录）. B stays a continuous line. Gap list attributes each interval to A or B.
browser_journey.last_valid: Header shows A 239C with original time 2026/11/18 12:07:39 and states 最后有效观测…非当前正常值; legend repeats 最后有效值，非当前.
browser_journey.late_sample: Hovering the late marker reports 值 150C, 观测 11:49:19, 接收于 12:07:39, 未参与当时实时控制. The late sample is an isolated dot and does not bridge the outage.
browser_journey.keyboard_mouse: Chart is focusable; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End move the readout across samples and events; mouse hover selects the exact marker (including quality events and late samples).
browser_journey.quality_summary: Derived from the same query records: 3402 normal, 2 quality events; no separate /ems/state or /ems/history query is used.
browser_journey.siot: No gap bands are drawn for the undeclared-cadence variable; the line is dashed, the note says 不推断缺口, and the summary labels 3 records as 质量未记录 rather than good.
browser_journey.empty: A configured-only point with no observations shows 所选范围内没有样本 and 无有效观测; it is not shown as zero.
browser_journey.failure: Injected 503 shows 查询失败 and 本次查询未成功，不能将无结果视为无数据; no empty-state claim is displayed.
browser_journey.loading: Delayed response shows 正在读取历史… before results.
browser_journey.aggregate: 5m mode keeps quality events as events, aggregates only good numeric observations, and splits on missing buckets rather than every bucket.

backend_semantics.declared_interval: historyPointResult.sample_interval_ms comes from BusConfig.Period (1000 ms); SIOT returns 0.
backend_semantics.quality_events: First failure or changed reason is recorded once as kind=quality_event with attempt time, no value and the actual reason. Expiry transition records source_expired once per Good→Stale transition.
backend_semantics.late: A strictly older valid observation is recorded with its true source time, received time and late=true; it is not accepted into current state and is not republished.
backend_semantics.storage: Events live in a separate per-point store, so /ems/history and demand calculations still see observations only; observations and events each keep their own bounded history.
backend_semantics.csv: Export keeps the task06 column order and appends 种类/原因 so quality events and late observations remain explainable; the 10000-row refusal still happens before any CSV header.
backend_semantics.siot: Native history has no quality or cadence; records keep quality empty and never claim good.

review_fix_pass.method: One fresh-context parallel Standards/Spec review, followed by one verified fix pass

fixed.proof: Marker now uses the series stroke; browser computed stroke rgb(192,122,31)

fixed.issue: Late samples could bridge a known invalid interval
fixed.proof: history-gaps check outage case: late sample stays an isolated dot; segments each length 1

fixed.issue: Gap bands had no point attribution
fixed.proof: Gap list names A or B; browser list separates A known gap from B continuous control

fixed.issue: Only quality events showed no reason list
fixed.proof: Events-only branch renders time, quality and localized reason

fixed.issue: SIOT undeclared cadence looked like a continuous normal line
fixed.proof: Undeclared series draw dashed and are labeled 质量未记录; no inferred gap

fixed.issue: Failure dedupe could suppress a real reason change
fixed.proof: Dedupe now compares against the last recorded event reason

fixed.issue: Duplicated store and record mapping code
Test-only EventLen API and unused test parameter
Bus fixture duplicated for a custom period

rejected.finding: CSV 种类/原因 columns are task06 scope creep
rejected.reason: Ticket 07 explicitly allows necessary field pass-through; without reasons the exported invalid rows would be unexplained

rejected.finding: Quality events in a dead point can exhaust history capacity
rejected.reason: Approved transition-only recording bounds events to failure-reason changes, and events have a separate per-point cap

deferred_minors: A/B boundary gaps repeat once per series; they are attributed and intentional

verification.go_full: go test -p 1 -count=1 ./... passed after the fix pass
verification.frontend_result: passed; existing Vite >500 kB chunk-size warning remains
verification.suite_note: Go packages run serially because existing integration fixtures share fixed ports

limits: Single Go service; no new time-series database
Isolated software simulator only; simulator is not hardware and no M5 sign-off is claimed
No production device connection, physical write or control bypass
No retention/cleanup policy, backfill, recalculation, settlement or ticket08 work
Native SIOT history without declared cadence does not infer gaps; only actual samples and explicit events are shown
No push, GitHub issue or PR

preservation.policy: Keep all original assets and backups; do not apply, pop or drop preserved unfinished work
